models_evaluated: SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) applied to machine learning models

links.outcome: Stability of SHAP feature attributions under Gaussian noise and feature omission (Jaccard, Spearman)
links.effect: Aggregate Jaccard index 0.778 and Spearman correlation 0.858 across noise intensities; proposed Global Stability Index 0.770; SPRR1B consistently identified.
links.quote: SHAP-based attributions maintain an aggregate Jaccard index of 0.778 and a Spearman correlation of 0.858 across various noise intensities, establishing their resilience in high-dimensional genomic spaces.

screen.reason: Evaluates the robustness/stability of SHAP explanations under data perturbation and noise as an XAI reliability benchmark/safeguard for oncology predictive models.

primary.practice: explainability stability testing under data perturbation
